reason: I buy my panels and batteries the way I always do. I walk the market, compare shop by shop, haggle, and my electrician wires it. Companies quoting full installed systems through an app will price higher than I can get myself, so I don't see why I'd send a request.
objection: These companies will quote package prices with their margin built in. The market is cheaper, and I trust my own electrician more than a company I found on an app.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that the offers come in at or below what I get haggling in the market, or a free check telling me whether the parts prices I was quoted at the shops are fair.
